parsed.answer: Immediately after the August 8 meeting, Mara’s Larch project was still approved for batch delivery using BATCH-0-741; no delivery-mode change was approved at that meeting.

citations.quote: They chose BATCH-0-741 for batch delivery.
No change of delivery mode was approved at this meeting.
